about: Zumi moods for the 3D mascot (design/mascot/3d/zumi-mascot.glb). Each expression is one glTF animation of the same name (30 fps, plays once and returns to neutral). blush is the blush opacity as a fraction of full (#FF8FA8); the GLB material carries the neutral level. closedEyes suppresses the random blink. calm suppresses random sway and squash.

body.note: one at a time, never overlapping

breathe.note: breathe and squash both drive the root scale; multiply them
